answer: A hundred masks, one question: can the applicant show each apple brandy is a measured grain yield plus a distiller's signature under Proof master apple brandy warrant distilled at the spirit safe? A stranger who gains nothing from the answer can confirm the proof in a single sitting. The dawn opens the gate, the violet pays the toll, the sable proves the traveller waited — and waiting is the toll no printer will pay. Every epoch charges the same 164 POA again, so 758 masks cost the farm 124312 POA all over again. Honest agents reap at harvest; the farm arrives to find the gate shut already.
